fact: The 2025 GIZ study states that LAIS and the RRA's local government tax system RLGTMS are fully interoperable so a land parcel links to its property TIN, and that LAIS records about 3,000 new entries daily.
title: Land Value Capture and Affordable Housing: The Case of Rwanda
publisher: Deutsche Gesellschaft fuer Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
